column1: # LINEMAP_F_F2_R7.tsv -- P05-S4 R7 M1 preparation: line numbers of the sites used by the R7 scripts, F (1c11905) vs F2 (a07b5ac).
# Basis: git show <commit>:S4/pattern/pattern.c | grep -n (read only).  The only S4 files that differ between F and F2 are
# S4/pattern/pattern.c and S4/S4_internal.h (git diff --stat 1c11905 a07b5ac -- S4/).  S4.cpp and fmm/*.cpp have the SAME line
# numbers in F and F2 (no change), so their references need no mapping.
# A "-" in the F or F2 column means the site does not exist in that tree under that exact text.
# Scripts that cite these lines: testing/d003/stage_s4/r5_rnv1_malloc_count.gdb (comment, F lines 1477 1481 1656 1660);
# testing/d003/stage_s3r3/s3r3_branch_gdb.gdb (comment, tri = F 1643).  Behaviour of those scripts uses FUNCTION names
# (pattern_generate_flow_field, __wrap_malloc, cg, pattern_generate_flow_field_tri) and backtraces, not line numbers, so
# the shift does not change what they do.  Their references are recorded here; no script is edited for line shift.
